summary: Georgia tower list places a tower called surrency in Appling County, the same name as the town; no history or present site found.

evidence.supports: A tower called surrency is listed in Appling County at 31.72287, -82.18977

notes_for_editor: Two sources only. The list's author says names for towers 73 and above are the author's own creation, so the match with the town's name may be the author's choice rather than a historical name; the story says so. The record's registers entry ('GFC US 802') is a Georgia Forestry Commission list reference (gfc-802) from the tnlandforms list, not a heritage register; consider moving it to a note or clearing it. The list gives elevation 183 with no units; the record converts it to 55.8 m as feet, which is unverified, so the story does not give an elevation. The Wikimedia Commons photo 'Appling County lookout tower' (CC BY-SA 4.0, Michael Rivera, 2016) was taken just outside Baxley at about 31.7225, -82.3764, near the tnlandforms Baxley entry (GA125), so it is not this tower and was not attached. Wikipedia's Surrency article does not mention a tower. A 2026 wildfire listing and property listings name a Fire Tower Road in Surrency; no source ties that road to this tower, so it is not used. No history, staffing or current condition was found.
